# mixutin

> mixutin is a cybersecurity specialist and CTF player who works on reverse engineering and game preservation. The main public project is Dauntless Revived, a private-server revival of the co-op monster-hunting game Dauntless, whose official servers shut down on 30 May 2025. It runs the genuine Dauntless 1.4.4 client against a self-hosted backend and is a modified fork of Undaunted by gwog (Gregory Morford) and contributors (AGPL-3.0).

This site is available in English and Finnish. Dauntless Revived is not a public server: it is run for a few friends, and anyone can self-host it from the repository. No game files are distributed by this site or the repository. It is not affiliated with Phoenix Labs or Epic Games; "Dauntless" is a trademark of its owners.

Skills: reverse engineering (game preservation, binary analysis, x86-64 disassembly, Windows PE analysis, Unreal Engine 4 internals), backend and servers (TypeScript, Node.js, Express, SQLite, Python with FastAPI), systems programming (C, C++, OpenBSD), game development and tools (Unity, C#, Luau/Roblox, Blender, MCP servers). Also private, unreleased work: game private servers for Angry Birds Go! and Naruto x Boruto: Ninja Voltage, and MCP servers that let AI coding assistants drive Blender, LibreSprite and Roblox Studio.

## Projects

- [Dauntless Revived: project page](https://mixutin.github.io/projects/dauntless-revived/): what it is, what works today, how it works, live roadmap progress, FAQ and credits
- [Dauntless Revived docs](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/): documentation home with current status and how the pieces fit together
- [Dauntless Revived FAQ](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/faq.html): common questions, such as whether Dauntless can still be played and whether an Epic account is needed
- [Dauntless Revived setup guide](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/): hosting the server, the friends' side, and checking that a copy of the 1.4.4 client is genuine
- [Dauntless Revived findings](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/): research notes on the backend contract, the server-mode DLL and the 2.1.1 client
- [Dauntless Revived roadmap](https://github.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived/blob/dauntless-revived/ROADMAP.md): the live checklist, milestones M0 to M4
- [Dauntless Revived source code](https://github.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived): GitHub repository, AGPL-3.0, branch dauntless-revived
- [Dauntless Revived docs llms.txt](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/llms.txt): index of the documentation site
- [Dauntless Revived docs llms-full.txt](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/llms-full.txt): the documentation as one text file
- [Undaunted](https://github.com/SyST3MDeV/Undaunted): the upstream open-source Dauntless server by gwog (Gregory Morford) and contributors
